params.text:
I was unable to complete the task of presenting the monthly count of successful orders from Jan to Nov 2022 in MM:COUNT format. The main obstacle was that I could not log into the Magento admin panel because the username and password input fields on the login page (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/) were not marked as interactive elements. Only two elements were interactive: the 'Forgot your password?' link and the 'Login' button. I tried multiple approaches including:

1. Direct clicking on login elements
2. Send_keys with Tab navigation
3. Password recovery page (which had interactive fields)
4. Customer login page (which had interactive fields but invalid credentials)
5. Alternative navigation methods

Without access to the admin dashboard, I could not retrieve the order data. The task requires accessing order statistics that would typically be found in the Magento admin panel under Reports > Sales > Orders or similar sections. Since I couldn't authenticate, I have no order count data to present.

simplified_steps.evaluation: Failed - I was unable to log into the Magento admin panel due to the username and password input fields not being marked as interactive elements. Only the 'Forgot your password?' link and 'Login' button were interactive. I tried multiple approaches including send_keys, Tab navigation, and alternative login methods, but none succeeded.
simplified_steps.memory: Step 30/30. Final step reached. I attempted to access the Magento admin panel to retrieve monthly successful order counts from Jan to Nov 2022 in MM:COUNT format. However, I was unable to log in because the username and password input fields were not marked as interactive elements on the login page. I tried the customer login page as an alternative but those credentials didn't work either.
